content_of_post_to_comment: Today a colleague mentioned that she suspects people have used AI to write when they use the Oxford comma. I about had a heart attack. I’ve given up the em-dash in most cases, but you will pry away my Oxford comma from my cold, dead hand.
comment: The funny thing is punctuation can become a cultural signal rather than a writing choice. Maybe the real shift is that we’re learning to distrust markers of care in language.
